title: 第十五章
slug: 国民校草是女生全本免费-国民校草是女生最新章节列表
content_zh:
博九来了逗宠物的心情，慵懒懒的嗓音：“有件事我倒是一直想做。”
“什么，什么？”陈晓东连忙问。
博九笑容浅浅的给他扔下了三个字：“睡他啊。”
陈晓东整个人像是被雷劈了一般，顿住了……
博九伸手拍了拍他的脸：“所以说，别和少爷我玩文字，没准真给你做出什么来，乖，去上课吧。”
“少爷！！”陈晓东一把抱住博九的胳膊：“你一定是开玩笑的对吧，少爷！”
博九只笑不语的将人推开。
陈晓东越看自家少爷的样子心里越忐忑，完了完了，以前少爷只是偷摸的暗恋，现在竟然想要睡人。
那可是秦少！
睡了他，岂不是要小命不保？
“少爷，你到底是什么时候开始有的这么污的心思！”这一边，陈晓东抱着头要疯！
那一边，博九越过林荫道，观察了一下四周的摄像头，嘴角勾了勾。
只要有网络的地方，想要找出一个推她的人来还不容易？
平板一竖，博九找了个人极少的顶楼坐下，蓝牙键盘链接，修长的手指一碰到键盘，让人眼花缭乱的指法，直指校园网络中心！
随着她的侵入，只见屏幕上跳出一个又一个的画面，总共３２个，以小窗口的方式共同呈现。
现在的博九，手上的平板画面已经和学校保安监控进行了实时同步。
也就是说学校里的每一个摄像头都成了她的眼睛。
一个回车键，画面固定在了之前的一幕。
博九拆了一个棒棒糖放进嘴里，薄唇扬了起来，眸光冰冷：“霍思雨？原来是她……”
不过，这到没有什么。

让博九挑眉的是她在平板里设置的网络防御墙传来的警报声。
真没有想到，之前入侵过她电脑的人竟然会这么契而不舍？
博九眸子一眯，手指又开始活动了起来。
这一次的指法比方才更有攻击性，那样的指法就像是来自荒漠的鹰，凶猛飞速，直取咽喉！
又一台电脑黑屏了！
胖子坐在校公办，看着自己坏掉的笔记本，非但没有沮丧，反而眼神热烈的瞅向了身旁的人：“秦总，找到他了！黑桃Z！”
“他？“校领导们一脸的疑问，秦少来学校不是视察的吗？怎么变成找人了？
秦漠薄唇微启，不多不少的四个字：”具体位置。“
“Ｂ栋教学楼楼顶！他刚刚入侵了学校的校园网！“胖子要多激动要多激动：“他现在应该还在那！”
秦漠没有停顿，唰了一下站起身来，大步朝着Ｂ栋教学楼走了过去。
喵系少爷连忙抱着兔子跟上，还有一大批声势浩大的黑衣保镖。
校领导们还不知道发生了什么事，只听到胖子说有人入侵了他们的校园网，纷纷都变了脸色！
远处，噼哩叭啦的键盘声还在继续。
秦漠身形修长的站在楼下，长腿背光而立，左手抄着裤带，身上还披着他没有换下来的纯黑战服，抬起头来看了一眼Ｂ栋教学楼的楼顶，深邃的眸子带出了点点薄光……
喜欢国民校草是女生请大家
content_en:
Bo Jiu was in the mood to tease a pet, and said in a lazy voice: "There is something I have always wanted to do."
"What, what?" Chen Xiaodong asked quickly.
Bo Jiu smiled lightly and told him three words: "Sleep with him."
Chen Xiaodong paused as if he had been struck by lightning...
Bo Jiu reached out and patted his face: "So, don't play words with me, young master. I might really do something for you. Be good and go to class."
"Master!!" Chen Xiaodong hugged Bo Jiu's arm: "You must be joking, right, Master!"
Bo Jiu just smiled and pushed the person away.
The more Chen Xiaodong looked at his young master, the more uneasy he felt. It was over. In the past, the young master only had a secret crush, but now he actually wanted to sleep with him.
That's Mr. Qin!
If you sleep with him, won't you risk your life?
"Master, when did you start having such dirty thoughts!" On this side, Chen Xiaodong was holding his head and going crazy!
On the other side, Bo Jiu crossed the avenue, looked at the cameras around him, and curled his lips.
As long as there is an Internet, it is not easy to find someone to push her?
With the tablet upright, Bo Jiu found a place on the top floor where there were very few people to sit down. The Bluetooth keyboard was connected. As soon as his slender fingers touched the keyboard, his dazzling fingering movements pointed directly at the campus network center!
As she invaded, one picture after another popped up on the screen, a total of 32, presented together in the form of small windows.
Now Bojiu, the tablet screen in his hand has been synchronized with the school security monitoring in real time.
In other words, every camera in the school became her eyes.
With a press of the Enter key, the screen was fixed at the previous scene.
Bo Jiu opened a lollipop and put it into his mouth, raised his thin lips, and said with cold eyes: "Huo Siyu? It turns out it's her..."
However, this is nothing.
What made Bojiu raise an eyebrow was the alarm sound coming from the network defense wall she had set up on her tablet.
I really didn't expect that the person who had hacked into her computer before would be so reluctant to leave her?
Bo Jiu narrowed his eyes and began to move his fingers again.
This time the fingering was more aggressive than before. It was like an eagle from the desert, flying fiercely and going straight for the throat!
Another computer has a black screen!
The fat man was sitting in the school office, looking at his broken notebook. Instead of being depressed, he looked at the person next to him with warm eyes: "Mr. Qin, we found him! Z of Spades!"
"Him?" The school leaders looked doubtful. Didn't Mr. Qin come to the school to inspect? How come you are looking for someone?
Qin Mo's thin lips parted slightly, and he said four words: "Specific location."
"The roof of teaching building B! He just invaded the school's campus network!" The fat man wanted to be more excited: "He should still be there now!"
Qin Mo didn't pause, stood up, and strode towards Teaching Building B.
The meow-type young master quickly followed with the rabbit in his arms, along with a large number of powerful bodyguards in black.
The school leaders didn't know what happened, but they all changed their expressions when they heard Fatty saying that someone had invaded their campus network!
In the distance, the crackling keyboard sound continued.
Qin Mo was standing downstairs with a slender figure, long legs and backlight. His left hand was holding the belt of his pants. He was still wearing the pure black battle uniform that he had not changed out of. He raised his head and glanced at the roof of the teaching building B, and his deep eyes brought out a little light...
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
